title: Daskam 29 — Mohinyavatāram
description: The nectar episode, Mohini, and Shiva's realization and praise.
translation_status: No sourced English translation was available in this intake; no translation has been supplied.

stanzas.sanskrit:
उद्गच्छतस्तव करादमृतं हरत्सु
दैत्येषु तानशरणाननुनीय देवान् ।
सद्यस्तिरोदधिथ देव भवत्प्रभावा-
-दुद्यत्स्वयूथ्यकलहा दितिजा बभूवुः ॥ २९-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan appeared in Dhanvantri form, carrying pot of nectar from the Milky Ocean. Asuras snatched the pot.  Bhagwan consoled the Devas and disappeared. Prompted by Maaya, Asuras started to fight among themselves.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
udgacchatastava karādamṛtaṁ haratsu
daityeṣu tānaśaraṇānanunīya devān |
sadyastirodadhitha deva bhavatprabhāvā-
-dudyatsvayūthyakalahā ditijā babhūvuḥ || 29-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
श्यामां रुचाऽपि वयसाऽपि तनुं तदानीं
प्राप्तोऽसि तुङ्गकुचमण्डलभङ्गुरां त्वम् ।
पीयूषकुम्भकलहं परिमुच्य सर्वे
तृष्णाकुलाः प्रतिययुस्त्वदुरोजकुम्भे ॥ २९-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan took a form of beautiful young lady. On seeing her, Asuras stopped their quarrel and got attracted to her. The Asuras approached the beautiful lady.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
śyāmāṁ rucā’pi vayasā’pi tanuṁ tadānīṁ
prāpto’si tuṅgakucamaṇḍalabhaṅgurāṁ tvam |
pīyūṣakumbhakalahaṁ parimucya sarve
tṛṣṇākulāḥ pratiyayustvadurojakumbhe || 29-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
का त्वं मृगाक्षि विभजस्व सुधामिमामि-
-त्यारूढरागविवशानभियाचतोऽमून् ।
विश्वस्यते मयि कथं कुलटास्मि दैत्या
इत्यालपन्नपि सुविश्वसितानतानीः ॥ २९-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The Asuras even gave the responsibility of apportioning the nectar to her.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kā tvaṁ mṛgākṣi vibhajasva sudhāmimāmi-
-tyārūḍharāgavivaśānabhiyācato’mūn |
viśvasyate mayi kathaṁ kulaṭāsmi daityā
ityālapannapi suviśvasitānatānīḥ || 29-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
मोदात्सुधाकलशमेषु ददत्सु सा त्वं
दुश्चेष्टितं मम सहध्वमिति ब्रुवाणा ।
पङ्क्तिप्रभेदविनिवेशितदेवदैत्या
लीलाविलासगतिभिः समदाः सुधां ताम् ॥ २९-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Readily and joyfully the Asuras gave the pot of nectar to Bhagwan who was in the form  as Mohini.  The Devas and Asuras were made to sit in separate rows. Keeping Asuras attracted to her charming personality, she distributed the entire nectar to the Devas.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
modātsudhākalaśameṣu dadatsu sā tvaṁ
duśceṣṭitaṁ mama sahadhvamiti bruvāṇā |
paṅktiprabhedaviniveśitadevadaityā
līlāvilāsagatibhiḥ samadāḥ sudhāṁ tām || 29-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अस्मास्वियं प्रणयिनीत्यसुरेषु तेषु
जोषं स्थितेष्वथ समाप्य सुधां सुरेषु ।
त्वं भक्तलोकवशगो निजरूपमेत्य
स्वर्भानुमर्धपरिपीतसुधं व्यलावीः ॥ २९-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: When the Asuras were wrongfully believing that Mohini were fond of them, Bhagwan finished the nectar among the Devas.  Then Bhagwan  took His own form  and beheaded the Asura Raahu who cunningly sat in the row of the Devas and drank the nectar.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
asmāsviyaṁ praṇayinītyasureṣu teṣu
joṣaṁ sthiteṣvatha samāpya sudhāṁ sureṣu |
tvaṁ bhaktalokavaśago nijarūpametya
svarbhānumardhaparipītasudhaṁ vyalāvīḥ || 29-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
त्वत्तः सुधाहरणयोग्यफलं परेषु
दत्त्वा गते त्वयि सुरैः खलु ते व्यगृह्णन् ।
घोरेऽथ मूर्छति रणे बलिदैत्यमाया-
-व्यामोहिते सुरगणे त्वमिहाविरासीः ॥ २९-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan disappeared after punishing the Asuras for snatching the pot of nectar. Angry with the cheating, Asuras battled fiercely with the Devas making them almost loose their consciousness by their mightiness and magic. Bhagwan then reappeared in the battle field.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tvattaḥ sudhāharaṇayogyaphalaṁ pareṣu
dattvā gate tvayi suraiḥ khalu te vyagṛhṇan |
ghore’tha mūrchati raṇe balidaityamāyā-
-vyāmohite suragaṇe tvamihāvirāsīḥ || 29-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
त्वं कालनेमिमथ मालिमुखान् जघन्थ
शक्रो जघान बलिजम्भवलान् सपाकान् ।
शुष्कार्द्रदुष्करवधे नमुचौ च लूने
फेनेन नारदगिरा न्यरुणो रणं त्वम् ॥ २९-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
Bhagwan reappeared and killed Kaalnemi, Maali and other Asuras. Indra killed Bali, Jaambvaan, Vaali and Bakaasura. 
Namuchi  asura was killed  by a weapon made of foam. 
The fight was stopped following Sage Narada's advice.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tvaṁ kālanemimatha mālimukhān jaghantha
śakro jaghāna balijambhavalān sapākān |
śuṣkārdraduṣkaravadhe namucau ca lūne
phenena nāradagirā nyaruṇo raṇaṁ tvam || 29-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
योषावपुर्दनुजमोहनमाहितं ते
श्रुत्वा विलोकनकुतूहलवान् महेशः ।
भूतैः समं गिरिजया च गतः पदं ते
स्तुत्वाऽब्रवीदभिमतं त्वमथो तिरोधाः ॥ २९-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Lord Shiva heard about the appearance of Bhagwan Vishnu in form of Mohini. He became eager to see and went to Bhagwan's abode along with Goddess Uma and Bhoothaganaas.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
yoṣāvapurdanujamohanamāhitaṁ te
śrutvā vilokanakutūhalavān maheśaḥ |
bhūtaiḥ samaṁ girijayā ca gataḥ padaṁ te
stutvā’bravīdabhimataṁ tvamatho tirodhāḥ || 29-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
आरामसीमनि च कन्दुकघातलीला-
-लोलायमाननयनां कमनीं मनोज्ञाम् ।
त्वामेष वीक्ष्य विगलद्वसनां मनोभू-
-वेगादनङ्गरिपुरङ्ग समालिलिङ्ग ॥ २९-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: In the garden, Shiva saw Bhagwan in the form of a most beautiful damsel, whose eyes roamed about as she played with a ball. Her robes were slipping down in the course of the movements. Although Lord Shiva was a conqueror of Kaamadeva, still he could not resist his desire to embrace Bhagwan.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ārāmasīmani ca kandukaghātalīlā-
-lolāyamānanayanāṁ kamanīṁ manojñām |
tvāmeṣa vīkṣya vigaladvasanāṁ manobhū-
-vegādanaṅgaripuraṅga samāliliṅga || 29-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
भूयोऽपि विद्रुतवतीमुपधाव्य देवो
वीर्यप्रमोक्षविकसत्परमार्थबोधः ।
त्वन्मानितस्तव महत्त्वमुवाच देव्यै
तत्तादृशस्त्वमव वातनिकेतनाथ ॥ २९-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Lord Shiva followed Mohini for some time, then he obtained the knowledge of the Brahmam and sang the glory of Bhagwan. Bhagwan honoured Shiva, who then narrated Bhagwan's greatness to Goddess Parvati.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
bhūyo’pi vidrutavatīmupadhāvya devo
vīryapramokṣavikasatparamārthabodhaḥ |
tvanmānitastava mahattvamuvāca devyai
tattādṛśastvamava vātaniketanātha || 29-10 ||
